title: Nostell Ghost Walks
description: Sat 21 Nov 2026 - Sat 28 Nov 2026 17:30 - 19:30 Nostell, National Trust £7.50 - £15 Book now Outdoor Tour Walk Share: About Join local ghost expert, The Curator (of Wakefield and Pontefract Ghost Walk fame), and delve into the spooky history of the Nostell estate. Enjoy a spooky walk through the parkland and gardens before returning to the front of the house to conclude the tour. Each participant will receive a handheld prop lantern to help uncover ghostly sightings along the way. Ghost sightings not guaranteed. The Nostell Ghost Walks are suitable for ages 12+ and under 16s must be accompanied by an adult. Please dress for the weather and wear suitable footwear, as paths may be uneven, wet or muddy.
